description: Solar-panel components, sensors and measurements relevant to ORBITALIS (battery subsystem excluded).

sources.citation: Jara Cespedes, A.J.; Pangestu, B.H.B.; Hanazawa, A.; Cho, M. Performance Evaluation of Machine Learning Methods for Anomaly Detection in CubeSat Solar Panels. Applied Sciences 2022, 12(17), 8634.

sections_used.2.1: BIRDS bus, five solar panels, two cells in series
sections_used.2.2: Dataset overview, sensors (Table 1), sampling rate 5 s for RAAVANA/UGUISU/NEPALISAT
sections_used.2.3: Orbit/attitude effects (eclipse, rotation) on panel readings
sections_used.3.1.1: Type 1 anomaly: solar panel failure, Eq. (1)
sections_used.3.1.2: Type 2 anomaly: solar cell failure, Eq. (2)

sources.verified: Full text read during ORBITALIS development; definitions transcribed exactly.

sources.citation: BIRDS Satellite Electrical Power System Dataset (BIRDS Open Source).

sections_used.workbooks: RAAVANA.xlsx and UGUISU.xlsx column names and values (inspected locally)

sources.verified: Used as the data source only. No threshold is taken from this reference.

components.name: +Y solar panel
components.description: Solar panel on the +Y side of the CubeSat. Two solar cells connected in series (SRC-1 Section 2.1).

components.name: +X solar panel
components.description: Solar panel on the +X side of the CubeSat. Two solar cells connected in series (SRC-1 Section 2.1).

components.name: -Z solar panel
components.description: Solar panel on the -Z side of the CubeSat. Two solar cells connected in series (SRC-1 Section 2.1).

components.name: -X solar panel
components.description: Solar panel on the -X side of the CubeSat. Two solar cells connected in series (SRC-1 Section 2.1).

components.name: +Z solar panel
components.description: Solar panel on the +Z side of the CubeSat. Two solar cells connected in series (SRC-1 Section 2.1).

measurements.name: Panel voltage
measurements.description: Output voltage of a panel. SRC-1 Section 3.1.1: the lowest expected reading of a non-illuminated panel lies within 1200-1500 mV (residual voltage of the ADC circuit).

measurements.name: Panel current
measurements.description: Output current of a panel. Significant current flows only after a potential difference to the DC/DC converter input is reached (SRC-1 Section 2.4).

measurements.name: Panel temperature
measurements.description: Temperature behind the panel. It lags voltage/current when entering or leaving eclipse, so SRC-1 did not use it for labelling; ORBITALIS shows it as context and as an ML feature only.

dataset_metadata.dataset: BIRDS EPS solar-panel telemetry (high sampling sensor data collection, one orbit per worksheet)
dataset_metadata.sampling_interval_source: SRC-1:2.2 (verified against the 'Time Stamp' column of every worksheet)
dataset_metadata.time_column: Time Stamp (elapsed seconds within the session)
dataset_metadata.label_note: The workbooks contain no label column. Documented failure conditions are derived from SRC-1 Eq.(1) and Eq.(2).
excluded_columns: all '(raw)' hexadecimal columns (calibrated values are used)

operating_context.description: Satellites have no attitude control and rotate freely (about 3 deg/s per axis, SRC-1 Section 2.3); illumination of each panel therefore changes continuously and eclipse alternates with sunlight. A low voltage on a single sample is not by itself a fault.
